title: Rethinking Multiplication in Neural Networks with Hadamard Transform-Assisted Operators
abstract: arXiv:2509.23103v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multiplication-avoiding neural operators are attractive for compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures, but directly replacing conventional convolutions often causes accuracy degradation. We investigate whether this limitation arises from multiplication avoidance itself or from the representation on which the operator acts. In this work, we introduce Hadamard Transform-assisted multiplication-avoiding (HMA) operators that combine Walsh--Hadamard transform features with multiplication-avoiding channel mixing. To identify where conventional multiplication remains necessary, we employ a gated formulation in which conventional and HMA operators compete through learned layer-wise coefficients. ResNet-18 experiments show that intermediate convolutional layers assign greater weight to HMA, whereas the earliest layers and final classifier retain greater contribution from conventional computation. translated_abstract: 避免乘法的神经算子对于存内计算架构具有吸引力，但直接替换传统卷积往往会导致精度下降。我们研究了这一限制究竟是源于避免乘法本身，还是源于算子所作用的表示形式。在本工作中，我们提出了Hadamard变换辅助的避免乘法（HMA）算子，将Walsh-Hadamard变换特征与避免乘法的通道混合相结合。为了确定传统乘法在何处仍然必要，我们采用了一种门控公式，使传统算子和HMA算子通过学习到的逐层系数进行竞争。ResNet-18实验表明，中间卷积层对HMA赋予了更大的权重，而最早的层和最终分类器则保留了传统计算的更大贡献。基于这一观察，我们构建了一个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出Hadamard变换辅助的避免乘法（HMA）算子，并通过门控竞争机制发现中间卷积层更适合采用HMA算子，而最早层和最终分类器仍需传统乘法，从而在存内计算架构中兼顾计算效率与模型精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Hadamard Transform-assisted multiplication-avoiding (HMA) operators, and a gated formulation reveals that intermediate convolutional layers favor HMA while the earliest layers and final classifier still require conventional multiplication, balancing efficiency and accuracy for compute-in-memory architectures.
